item.title: 2027: We’re not in merger talk with anyone, we’ll stand alone – Labour Party
item.description: The Labour Party has said it is not in any merger talk with any political party ahead of the 2027 general elections. Special Adviser to Nenadi-Usman, the Interim National Chairman of the Labour Party, Ken Asogwa, made this known on Tuesday during an interview on Arise Television. Asogwa said the Labour Party will stand alone in the forthcoming general elections as it did in 2023. item.title: Only N60m released from N858bn budgeted to bridge electricity tariff gap, NBET tells senate
item.description: The Nigerian Bulk Electricity Trading (NBET) Plc has told the senate that only N60 million was released out of the N858 billion appropriated in the 2025 capital budget to bridge the electricity tariff shortfall. Johnson Akinnawo, acting managing director of NBET, spoke on Thursday during the agency’s 2025 budget performance review and defence of its 2026 proposal before the senate committee on finance chaired by Sani Musa, Niger east senator. item.title: UK to issue only eVisas for visitors from Feb 25
item.description: The United Kingdom (UK) has announced a major shift in its visa system, confirming that from February 25, 2026, visitors who require a visa will receive only an electronic visa (eVisa).The update was disclosed by UK Visas and Immigration (UKVI) in a post on X (formerly Twitter), where the agency wrote: “From 25 February 2026 visitors to the UK, who need a visa, will get an eVisa only.
